items.raw_excerpt: Quinta da Pacheca is one of those places that almost doesn’t feel real when you first arrive.
items.summary_en: Quinta da Pacheca is a wine estate hotel in Portugal's Douro Valley that feels almost surreal when you first arrive. Set among terraced vineyards, it blends historic charm with luxury, offering a memorable and intimate stay in one of the world's oldest wine regions.

items.raw_excerpt: Sam Draper walked into a successful program that had just won back-to-back premierships. He helped it secure its third.
items.summary_en: Sam Draper was not sure last year that he would play tennis again. He joined a strong program that had won two titles in a row. In his first season there, he helped it reach the top again and won the title himself.

items.raw_excerpt: Tras cinco meses en el mar y más de 37.000 kilómetros recorridos (20.164 millas náuticas), el Buque Escuela Esmeralda regresó este sábado a Valparaíso, marcando el fin de su septuagésimo crucero de instrucción. La travesía combinó la formación profesional de guardiamarinas y marineros con labores de representación internacional por diversos puertos de Chile y el extranjero. La llegada de la "Dama Blanca" a la bahía de Valparaíso estuvo marcada por una tradicional bienvenida. Antes de atracar en
items.summary_en: The Chilean navy training ship Esmeralda came home to Valparaiso on Saturday after five months at sea. It finished its 70th training cruise, traveling more than 37,000 kilometers. Families and crowds welcomed the ship, known as the White Lady, with hugs and kisses at the port.
items.summary_ko: 칩레의 폀로 학산 소다 에스먼다다 스로건에 5년 달 다음 폀해 통합으로 바라페이오에로 담애난다. 37,000기로 나다시를 동부하여 70번짴 생내 수업 종료을 끝단을 마무다. 공식은 상임 이마지를 보드담으로 얬리로 용성하고 평닭도 있었다.
items.title_en: Training Ship Esmeralda Returns to Valparaiso After Five Months at Sea
items.title_ko: 햸리화 학산 소다 에스먼다 리다, 5년 달 함구이 상헼 밀다로 만다스
